title: pure creation and fun
description: this is a extremeley heavy -weight create mod modpack with over 50 create addons and more
body:
This is a modpack based around the create mod adding tons of new features with over 50 create addons,shaders and resource packs all preloaded in one pack making it easy to disable or enable different settings without having to closing and reopening minecraft when you want somwthing new.
Note:only use on mid-high end systems i sadly cant feature gallery images because i have a low-end system and my game kept crashing
Also remember to enable your resource packs by going to: options>resource packs and eanble whichever you like
and also your shaders(only shaders recommended for mid end systems is "mellow") by going to: options>graphics>shaders and enable whichever you like and fits youre system. Have Fun:)
Update:mod doesent work on some neoforge versions for unknown reasons
GoTo the [Updated version](https://modrinth.com/modpack/pure-creation-and-fun-reworked)
